items.text:
LA  INDEPENDENT ACTORS/ACTRESSES WANTED FOR TEST FOOTAGE FOR FEATURE
Looking for a small cast to help take some test footage around the SGV and Pasadena area. 

This footage is from a feature film of mine, the script is completed but only looking to film one or two scenes.

This is a comedy/drama set during COVID. 

No payment, however you can keep whatever footage is taken of you and I will cast you as a member of the cast on IMDB.

Test footage will be shot on a Panasonic G85, all footage will be shot outside during the day in a public area.

(Near downtown Pasadena - Colorado/Lake)

LEAD ACTRESS: mid 20s/white/blonde hair (bleach or natural)

LEAD ACTOR: mid 20s/hispanic or white/a bit overweight

This is a unified project with me as writer/director/producer. 

No online transactions of copyrighted content. (We don’t send scripts online)

Will need to meet beforehand a few days prior to shooting, you will be provided with a physical copy of the scene. (Usually at Tops burgers or the Inn & Out on Walnut)

Serious inquiries only.

Union/Non-union I don’t really care. 

- C. Tano

PILNE!!! UWAGA!!! PILNE!!!

Do jednego z ostatnich odcinków sezonu 21 serialu GLINIARZE realizowanego w Warszawie oraz bliskich okolicach szukam PANÓW:

- „Patyk” (22) – Łukasz Bator. Drobny diler. Handluje wśród znajomych.
Data: 18.08 i 21.08
Stawka: 800 zł netto za 2 dni

-Diler (28) – Jarosław Lipa. Lokalny diler. Z charakteru cwaniak. 
Data: 17.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

- Krupier (39) – Adrian Zawadzki. Krupier w kasynie. Jego mimika nie wyraża emocji dzięki czemu sprawdza się w swojej pracy.
Data: 17.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

-  Sąsiad (54) – kryje Mściciela, gdy ten „robi porządek” w dzielnicy. 
Data: 18.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

- Gracz 1 (45) – klient kasyna. 
Data: 17.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

- Gracz 2 (30) – klient kasyna. 
Data: 17.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

- Gangus 1 (30-40) – bezwzględny zbir.
Data: 18.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

- Gangus 2 (30-40) – bezwzględny zbir.
Data: 18.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o zgłoszenia WYŁĄCZNIE MAILOWO na adres: outsetola@op.pl

W tytule e-maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.
W treści:
- Wiek, wzrost, waga
- Numer telefonu
- Informacje o dotychczasowym doświadczeniu przed kamerą
- Linki do swoich materiałów video: wizytówka/demo/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę do nagrania scenę ze scenariusza)
- Aktualne zdjęcie
- Informacja czy grali Państwo w przeszłości w Gliniarzach lub Gliniarzach Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu i noclegu

🎸 Get Ready to Rock, Chester! 🎸
Looking for a fantastic family night out this August?

Hit Musical School of Rock comes to the stage at Storyhouse, Chester!

Packed with iconic rock songs, hilarious moments, and incredible performances from our talented young cast, this is a show guaranteed to have you singing along and cheering from start to finish.

📅 13-15 August
📍 Storyhouse, Chester
🎟️ Book your tickets today:
https://www.storyhouse.com/whats-on/mapa-school-of-rock/

Whether you're a fan of the movie, love live theatre, or simply want to support local young talent, we'd love to see you there. Bring your family, invite your friends, and join us for a show that's full of energy, heart and rock 'n' roll!
🎸 Don't miss it - grab your tickets now and come rock with us! 🤘

Do ostatnich odcinków 21. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie
(i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję mężczyzn do następujących ról:

-Gangus 1 (30) – napakowany trep 
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

-Nitrox (33) – Haker z darknetu, który sprzedaje fałszywe dokumenty. Stara się nie wyróżniać
Data: 20.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

-Tomasz Kubik, ps. Heniek (35)  – brutalny i okrutny facet, bezmyślny prostak. 
Data: 19, 20 i 21.08
Stawka: 1800 zł netto za całość

-Barman (36) – szemrany typek, stoi za barem w knajpie. 
Data: 20.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

-Drogosz (37) – Typ stalkera, ma problemy z nawiązywaniem kontaktów z kobietami, sfrustrowany i z problemami, zdolny do porwania nastolatki. Łatwo się zakochuje i nie odpuszcza.
Data: 20 i 21.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

-Gangus 2 (40) – dobrze zbudowany kryminalista, epizod bez tekstu. KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Sceny: 2, 3, PPS-8
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

-Mechanik, ps. Radek (45) – szemrany mechanik, który zajmuje się paserką.
Data: 20.08
Stawka: 500 zł netto

-Ochroniarz (50) – typowy ochroniarz z niewielkiej agencji. KONIECZNE PRAWO JAZDY
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 300 zł netto

-Tata Kai (50) – Załamany ojciec porwanej dziewczyny. Stara się trzymać, ale mocno przeżywa sytuację
Data: 21.08
Stawka: 400 zł netto

-Łukasz Kruk (51) – Ojciec nastolatka, szanowany prawnik, który za wszelką cenę chce pomóc synowi uniknąć kary. Inteligentny, zna kruczki prawne. Elegancki.
Data: 20 i 22.08
Stawka: 1200 zł netto za całość

-Świadek (65) – typ emeryta z małej miejscowości, z psem. Szukamy pana z własnym pieskiem
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 700 zł netto za całość

-Ratownik – Ratownik ZRM
Data: 21.08

We are currently casting a **grandmother role** for an upcoming film production shooting on **August 10 in Middletown, Connecticut**. 

We are looking for a **woman, age 70+**, to play a grandmother attending a summer wedding. 

**Casting Details:**

• **Non-union**
• **Non-paid opportunity**
• **Mileage reimbursement of $0.30 per mile**
• **Filming window: 3:00 PM–8:00 PM**
• Talent must self-report to the filming location in Middletown, Connecticut
• Talent must provide their own **upscale summer wedding attire**
• **Featured role with one speaking line**

The production will feature **Ryan Eggold and Tyler Labine**, known for their roles in the television series *New Amsterdam*.

We are especially looking for someone who can naturally portray a **warm grandmother** at a summer wedding.

If you or someone you know may be interested, please email me at **[madisonparler22@gmail.com](mailto:madisonparler22@gmail.com)**

**TITLE: "BASED ON A POST"** — Non-Union Short Film

**CASTING:**
Seeking a large ensemble of everyday faces for a series of short vignettes, shot on Kodak 35mm film.

**Roles Available:**
* Teens, playing ages 16–18 (**actor must be 18+**)
* Young Adults, ages 18–25
* Adults, late 20s–40s
* Seniors, 50+

No experience required. We're looking primarily for natural presence, authenticity, and grounded performances. Each performer appears in a brief but featured moment as part of the film's larger story.

**LOCATION:**
Los Angeles, CA, USA (Local hire only)

**COMPENSATION:**
Select roles paid up to **$150**. Other roles are unpaid. All performers receive screen credit and footage for their reel.

**CONTACT:**
**[BasedOnAPost@gmail.com](mailto:BasedOnAPost@gmail.com)**
* To submit, email a recent headshot/photo and any demo reel or performance footage you may have.

**Submission Deadline:** Rolling submissions

**Auditions:** Selected actors will be invited to submit a self-taped audition.

**Production:** Filming over the next **2–3 months**. Each vignette is scheduled individually, with flexible scheduling around cast availability. Most roles are expected to require **one shoot day (up to 4 hou**r**s)**

Hi, I’m Michael — a cinematographer and photographer who recently relocated from Connecticut to Central Florida.

I’m currently looking to connect with **models, actors, directors, filmmakers, photographers, and fellow creatives** interested in collaborating on exciting visual projects. I’m always open to meeting like-minded artists and building creative partnerships that bring unique ideas to life.

I also offer **professional cinematography and photography services** for individuals, brands, productions, events, and creative projects.

Whether you’re looking to create cinematic content, capture professional portraits, build your portfolio, produce promotional visuals, or develop a creative concept from the ground up, I’d love to connect.

📍 Central Florida
🎥 Cinematography | Film & Video Production
📸 Photography | Portraits | Creative & Commercial Work
🤝 Collaborations & Creative Projects

If you’re interested in working together or have a project in mind, feel free to **send me a message**. I’m always excited to meet new creatives and create something great together.

Are you a writer or creative sitting on sketch ideas you can't get made? Or an actor who needs footage and can't find anyone to shoot with?
That's the problem Collective VYBEz exists to solve.
We're a group of actors, writers, and creatives in Birmingham and surrounding areas who meet up and actually make things. A typical meeting: warm-ups and acting games, we read through scripts, then break into groups and build a sketch. You leave having made something.
Everything we shoot is yours to use. Put it on your demo reel, your portfolio, your submissions. No
 charge, no catch. Free footage is hard to come by around here and that's most of the point.
You don't need experience. You don't need to be funny yet. You need to show up.
We meet in Birmingham on Sundays or Mondays at 6. Free, always.
Comment below or send me a message and I'll get you the details.

🎬 **Schauspieler / Kleindarsteller / Komparse aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

Hallo zusammen,

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin 41 Jahre alt, 1,94 m groß und lebe in Hamburg.

Ich bin aktuell auf der Suche nach **seriösen Film- und TV-Produktionen sowie Möglichkeiten als Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse** – gerne für Filme, Serien, Werbespots, Musikvideos, Imagefilme oder andere spannende Projekte.

Ich stehe noch **am Anfang meiner schauspielerischen Laufbahn** und möchte in erster Linie weitere Erfahrungen vor der Kamera sammeln, mich weiterentwickeln und verschiedene Einblicke in die Film- und Medienbranche bekommen.

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits als **Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude gemacht und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig noch häufiger vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig** und freue mich darauf, neue Erfahrungen zu sammeln und mich auf unterschiedliche Projekte einzulassen.

Ich bin sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** offen. Anfragen aus Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich über eine Nachricht. **Aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** sende ich gerne auf Anfrage zu.

Ich freue mich über interessante Projekte, neue Erfahrungen und nette Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche!

Viele Grüße
Nicolay Bein

Ich bin sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** offen. Anfragen aus Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich über eine Nachricht. **Aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** sende ich gerne auf Anfrage zu.

Ich freue mich über interessante Projekte, neue Erfahrungen und nette Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche!

Viele Grüße
Nicolay Bein

URGENT : Recherche Hommes CORÉENS pour le LUNDI 10 AOÛT

Bonjour à toutes et à tous !

Je cherche encore des H et des F tous âges d’origine coréenne pour le Lundi 10 AOÛT( surtout des hommes )pour un tournage dans PARIS( 8eme ).

Horaires prévisionnels : 08h30/19h00

Merci de ne pas postuler si vous ne faites pas de figuration, d’indiquer impérativement vos disponibilités/indisponibilités entre le 07 et le 14 août. 

Rémunération : cachet 98 euros bruts + éventuelles heures sup/heures de nuit si il y a + majoration silhouette 42,24 si applicable.

Pour le LUNDI 10 AOÛT 

-Des H/F CORÉENS, pour incarner une délégation de l’ONU puis des clients très sélects de ce même restaurant 

-Des hommes et des femmes entre 30 et 55 ans( âge apparent ), toutes origines, très BCBG, physiques type mannequins bienvenus, avec une garde robe très luxe.

Pour incarner la clientèle d’un restaurant réservé à l’élite. 

Pour le VENDREDI 14 AOÛT :

Un couple très chic en silhouette avec éventuellement un véhicule de luxe( défraiement prévu pour la voiture )

Il n’y a pas d’autres dates prévues sur Paris avant la rentrée merci donc de ne pas postuler si vous n’êtes pas disponibles sur cette période. 

Pour toutes et tous, merci par avance de ne pas postuler si vous ne correspondez pas et DE NE PAS POSTULER à nouveau si vous avez déjà postulé.

Si vous êtes intéressé(e)s, disponibles, que vous correspondez aux critères et que vous N’AVEZ PAS D’IMPÉRATIF HORAIRE sur le ou les jours pour lesquels vous postulez, merci de me faire parvenir votre candidature à l’adresse suivante : 

Uas.casting@gmail.com

IMPORTANT merci de préciser en OBJET de votre mail le décor avec la date pour laquelle vous postulez + votre spécificité, votre âge, NOM + Prénom, mensurations :  exemple «  02 AOÛT COUNTRY CLUB Marc SIMON, 35 ans, 1m80, 78kg joueur TENNIS pro » ou « Homme Métis, Martin BRILLON, , 40 ans, 1m80, 70kg » etc, etc… 

Votre CANDIDATURE doit comprendre IMPÉRATIVEMENT les éléments suivants sinon elle ne sera pas traitée :

-Vos indisponibilités( ou disponibilités )entre le 07 AOÛT et le 14 AOÛT 

-VOS MENSURATIONS COMPLÈTES( taille, poids, veste, haut, pantalon, chaussures ) 

-Origines ethniques 

-Couleur des yeux

-Couleur des cheveux 

- NOM et Prénom (pas de pseudonyme)

- NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE 

-Date et lieu de naissance 

-Lieu de résidence( adresse complète )

-2 à 3 photos de vous récentes( dont portrait, en pied et un selfie pris aujourd’hui, sans filtre )

-Préciser votre niveau de tennis ou de squash si vous pratiquez ces sports 

-Préciser si vous avez des expériences de service, des compétences particulières quelles qu’elles soient etc etc 

-Préciser si vous avez des tatouages, des piercings, des cheveux colorés etc.. car nous cherchons régulièrement des gens aux looks atypiques( pas trop sur ce projet mais on ne sait jamais 😉

-Préciser, si vous le souhaitez, si vous avez eu recours à la chirurgie esthétique 

-Préciser si vous avez des tenues très chic/luxe/gala. N’hésitez pas à envoyer des photos de vos tenues si vous le pouvez !

-N’hésitez pas à envoyer des photos de vos tenues de sport si vous disposez de tenues très luxes/classes 

-Préciser si vous disposez de tenues en rapport avec de futurs potentiels décors( serveurs, sportifs, sécu etc … )

N’hésitez pas à joindre des photos de vous en tenues si vous avez.

-Préciser toutes les langues que vous parlez et le niveau et tout accent spécifique que vous pourriez avoir 

-Un CV et une bande démo( si vous avez )pour mon fichier et pour d’éventuelles silhouettes.

-N’hésitez pas à préciser si vous avez des talents particuliers : cascade, sport à haut niveau, musicien, danseur, etc etc 

-Préciser si vous êtes autonomes et par quel moyen( voiture, scooter, vélo, trottinette etc )

-Préciser si vous êtes ok pour faire du co voiturage pour les personnes disposant d’une voiture

-Préciser la marque et la couleur de votre voiture 

-Des photos de votre voiture, scooter, vélo etc pour celles et ceux qui en ont.

Par avance désolée car je ne pourrai malheureusement pas répondre à tout le monde. Je vous re contacterai dès que possible si votre profil correspond. 

Merci par avance à toutes et à tous pour vos futurs envois et belle journée ! 🙂

Anne Arovas, assistée d’Angèle Chenais

Uas.casting@gmail.com

Monteur vidéo – Disponible pour vos projets ! 🎬
Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Je m’appelle Matthew Dehlinger et je propose désormais mes services en tant que monteur vidéo.

Le montage est une véritable passion pour moi depuis plusieurs années. J’ai notamment réalisé le montage de mes propres courts-métrages, bandes-annonces, teasers, vidéos promotionnelles ainsi que de nombreux formats destinés aux réseaux sociaux.

Aujourd’hui, je souhaite mettre cette expérience au service d’autres personnes et collaborer sur de nouveaux projets.

Je peux notamment réaliser :
• Le montage de courts-métrages !
• Des bandes-annonces et teasers !
• Des vidéos promotionnelles !
• Des vidéos pour les réseaux sociaux !
• Et d’autres projets selon vos besoins !

Je suis à l’écoute de vos idées et je prends le temps de réaliser un montage qui correspond à vos attentes. Des retouches sont bien sûr possibles afin d’obtenir le meilleur résultat.

Je propose actuellement des tarifs de lancement, le temps de développer mon activité et d’enrichir mon portfolio ! 💰

Vous trouverez ci-dessous plusieurs exemples de mes réalisations. Toutes les vidéos présentées ont été montées par mes soins.

https://youtube.com/@thefivestarsstudio?si=iV8duhnGeYQ1b6B9

https://youtu.be/-iAUApGW5Sk?is=IPXELDNz3IoRpXe8

Vous pouvez également découvrir d’autres projets sur le compte Instagram de mes courts-métrages.

https://www.instagram.com/thefivestarsstudio?igsh=cmc5cDZib2RnMHlz

📩 Pour toute question ou pour discuter de votre projet, n’hésitez pas à me contacter en message privé ou directement sur mon compte Instagram.

https://www.instagram.com/matth_117d?igsh=MW1icHR4eTh6M2k5Zw==

Au plaisir de collaborer avec vous !

Matthew Dehlinger

🎬 CAST & CREW CALL — (Short Film) — Pueblo / Colorado Springs

Moonstream Pictures is casting a short comedy thriller shooting in the Pueblo / Colorado Springs area.

THE FILM: Kaylee, 22, just got fired and rent was due Tuesday. Her best friend tells her about an app — contract work, pick your own jobs, pays same night.

ROLES (both female, 18–25):

KAYLEE — LEAD. Warm, funny, a little in over her head. Starts the movie treating a threatening message like a customer service call and ends it somewhere very different.

BRITT — SUPPORTING LEAD. Kaylee's best friend. Knows more than she's saying. Quiet, level.

No experience required. If you've done a little acting, a lot of acting, or nothing at all and you've just always wanted to try — audition.

CREW — COME LEARN ON SET:

This is a set for people who want to do the job, not fetch coffee while somebody else does it. Everybody gets hands on gear.

MAKEUP / SFX — everyday looks plus practical blood effects. Messy, fun, and we'll walk you through it.

GRIP — rigging, stands, flags, moving and shaping light. The best crash course in how a set actually works.

SOUND — boom operator / location recordist. Hugely in demand and almost nobody in this area does it well. Learn it and you'll never be out of work.

ANY OTHER ROLE YOU'VE BEEN WANTING TO TRY — camera assistant, script supervisor, gaffer, production assistant, editor, BTS photographer. If there's a job on a film set you've been curious about and can't get anyone to let you try, tell me which one. We'll find a way to put you in it.

You do not need experience, gear, or a reel. You need to show up on time and be willing to learn. Everyone's a first-timer once, and this is a good place to be one.

THE DEAL — please read:

Unpaid.

Food and gas covered for every shoot day.

Full credit on the film and IMDb.

Footage for your reel, plus a copy of the finished short.

Small crew, short days, genuinely fun set. Meet some good people and network.

SCHEDULE: Shoot dates are still being set. Since this is a low-budget volunteer production, we'll do our best to build the schedule around what works for the people who sign on — jobs, school, and all of it. Tell us your availability and we'll work with it.

CONTENT NOTE: The film contains intense scenes, stage blood, and a physical struggle between the two leads. Nothing sexual, nothing nude. Choreographed and rehearsed, safety first, always. Please only apply if you're comfortable with that material — happy to talk through it before you commit.

TO APPLY: Reach out with a photo, your age, and anything you've done (or "nothing yet," which is a perfectly good answer as long as you can record yourself with a phone doing some auditions). Sides available for audition on request.

📩 Message me here on Facebook

📷 Instagram: @moonstreampics

✉️ Email: moonstreampictures@gmail.com

Full script available to anyone who's seriously interested.

items.text:
CASTING CALL FOR PROOF OF CONCEPT SHORT FILM

Are you a collaborator, ready for an opportunity? If you’re ready to take a leap to do something you’ve always wanted to do, with someone ready to give you that chance, THIS is the movie for you. I’m seeking dynamic, smart, funny cast members to shoot  a comedy scene from my feature, Cheddar Pop. 

“Cheddar Pop, is an independent, privately funded, feature that I wrote and will be producing from the ground up this year. It’s a comedy about a group of young movie theater workers who learn to rely on themselves and each other as they attempt to unionize their workplace.”

Feature Film: “Cheddar Pop”
Location: Greater Parker, CO. Area

Shoot Dates: September 1, 2026 must be available for rehearsals week of August 21-28. 

Project Type: Independent Feature Film (non-union, yes, we get the irony here)

Compensation: Unpaid, meals provided. 

Genre: Comedy

Logline: A group of theater employees find solidarity as they attempt to unionize their workplace and return to what made Cheddar’s Cinema a great place to work. Taking a stand at the concessions stand!

4 roles available. 2 female 2 male ages 18-25, Any level of experience. 

GEORGIA – Age 22—Theater Crew
Disgruntled and disillusioned, Georgia is stuck in a job that used to be her dream but now is draining her of all enthusiasm.

STELLA – Age 21—Theater Crew
Georgia’s best friend and greatest champion. Bubbly, energetic, and enthusiastic.

ROBBIE—Age 21—Theater Crew
Took a job at the theater for summer at the same time as his friend Kevin. The money’s okay for now, but always looking for something better. Just passing time.

KEVIN—Age 19—Theater Crew
Robbie’s best friend. Loves working at the theater because it keeps him close to his first passion, movies.

Email cheddarpopmovie@gmail.com for sides and Audition Notes. Submissions due by August 14, 2026.

Calling all Colorado filmmakers! We are hitting the road and bringing the community together for an epic series of events stretching across the Front Range, starting in Boulder, moving to Denver, heading down to Colorado Springs, and ending in Pueblo. Whether you are a director, cinematographer, actor, screenwriter, editor, composer, etc or even a business looking to hire a talented videographer, these events are where you need to be for networking and meeting new people. Make sure to mark your calendars! A massive thank you to our incredible venue partners; Rayback Collective, Blend.Co, and The Brit Pub—for hosting us and supporting local talent. Make sure to stay tuned, as we will be announcing the official location for our Kick Ass X-Mas Party in Pueblo.

✨ CASTING CALL: THE NORTH POLE EXPERIENCE ✨
Are you ready to bring the magic of Christmas to life? We are now casting dynamic, warm, and versatile performers for The North Pole Experience in Liverpool!

We are seeking performers of all genders (18+) for Principal, Supporting, and Operational roles across our festive attractions.

📍 Location: Liverpool (L17), United Kingdom

🎭 Roles: Principal, Supporting & Operational Roles

📆 Contract: Mid-November – Late December

What We’re Looking For
 * Principal Roles: Previous professional acting experience required.

📅 Key Dates (Full Availability Required)
 * Rehearsals: Select dates during week commencing 16th November. Role dependant.

 * Tech Rehearsals: 21st & 22nd November
 * Friends & Family Preview: 27th November
 * Opening Day: 28th November 🎅
 * Charity Day: 2nd December (select characters)
 * Show Days: 5th, 6th, 12th, 13th, 19th, 20th, 21st, 23rd & 24th December
 * Additional Performance Days (Otterspool Grotto - select characters): 4th, 10th, 11th, 17th & 18th December.

Working hours operate on staggered start and finish times from 8:00am onwards, with finishes from 5:30pm onwards depending on character allocation. Cast members should be prepared for full-day shifts however certain days will have later starts and/or earlier finishes.

💰 Pay & Perks
 * Performance Days: Paid at up to £160 per day (depending on role and experience).

 * Rehearsal Days: Paid hourly at National Minimum Wage (NMW) for your age group.

 * Perks: Complimentary lunch and refreshments provided on all performance days, free tickets for our Friends & Family Preview, plus staff discounts in our on-site merchandise shop.

📩 How to Apply
Please email casting@thenorthpoleexperience.co.uk with the following details:

 * Full Name & Contact Details (Phone number & email address)

items.text:
WE'RE HIRING — LAPLANDUK 2026
Pay: £12.25–£14.50 per hour + 12.07% holiday pay

You must be 18 or over to apply.

LaplandUK is now recruiting for Christmas 2026.

Every year, more than 180,000 guests visit LaplandUK to experience one of the UK's most celebrated immersive Christmas events. We're looking for friendly, enthusiastic people to help create magical memories for families across a range of seasonal roles.

We're recruiting for:

Magic Elf – Bring the magical world of LaplandUK to life through storytelling, performance and unforgettable guest interactions.

Guest Experience Host – Welcome and guide families through their magical LaplandUK journey, ensuring every guest has an exceptional experience.

Retail Assistant – Help guests find the perfect gifts, operate tills and deliver outstanding customer service in our festive shops.

Food & Beverage Assistant – Operate tills, serve food and drinks while creating a warm, friendly and efficient dining experience.

Ice Skater – Support families at our Frozen Pond as a Skate Hire Assistant or Ice Marshal, helping guests enjoy the ice safely and confidently.

What's included:

Paid seasonal contract (November to December), including paid training

£12.25–£14.50 per hour + 12.07% holiday pay

Flexible shifts available across 7 days a week

Free shuttle service from the nearest train station

Free on-site parking

Free hot meal on every shift

Please note:

No previous experience required

Must be available for at least 3 shifts per week

No visible neck or lower arm tattoos due to costume requirements

To apply:

Complete our Google Form using the link below. Once you've submitted the form, our Recruitment Team will review your details and contact you with the next steps.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeVhuxLIfQqIE_UAKZDaXmp5BufJ3P-UU5jZKwqERX7JwRLHw/viewform

Any questions?

Please email resourcing@lapland.group and a member of the Recruitment Team will be happy to help.

Please share this post or tag someone who would love to be part of creating magical Christmas memories at LaplandUK.

sharedPost.text:
This Halloween the monsters are the ones who should be afraid. 🩸

Tickets are officially ON SALE for the UK amateur premiere of Dracula: A Feminist Revenge Fantasy, Really by Kate Hamill, presented by Dark Theatre Rochdale.

Forget the helpless victims of classic lore. 
This production is stylish, dark, and deeply subversive. 
We are turning Bram Stoker's horror tale completely upside down, blending terrifying gothic chills with brilliant, pitch-black humour. 
The women are fighting back, and it is going to get bloody. 🧛‍♀️🖤

📅 29th – 31st October 2026
📍 St Aidan's Hall, Rochdale

Seats are strictly limited for this exclusive three-night landmark run. 

Grab yours before they vanish into the night.

🎟️ Link to book now
https://buytickets.at/darktheatrerochdale

SUPPORTING ARTISTES WANTED FOR THE N.E.S.T. PROJECT!

We are looking for enthusiastic supporting artistes to join us for our upcoming filming scenes.

This is an incredible opportunity to step onto a real film set, experience the world of filmmaking, and become part of a growing independent feature film production.

Whether you are looking to gain on-set experience, develop your skills, meet like-minded creatives, or simply be part of something exciting, this is your chance.

By joining us, you will gain:

Real on-set experience
The opportunity to network with cast and crew
Insight into professional filmmaking processes
The chance to develop your understanding of how a production works
A unique experience being part of an ambitious feature film project

No previous experience is required. We are looking for people with enthusiasm, commitment, and a willingness to get involved.

N.E.S.T. is more than just a film; it is a community of creatives coming together to build something ambitious. We would love for you to be part of the journey.

If you are interested in joining us, reach out to find out more information.

info@emberproduction.com
Casting Director - Simon Hall: +44 7894 943405

items.text:
🔥 BOSTON BURNING

A New Original Series

Premise:
Greg Marker, 28, is a respected Boston firefighter hiding a terrifying secret: he is an arsonist himself. When copycat arsonists begin setting fires across the city, Greg realizes someone is imitating his work. What begins as a confrontation between Greg and the copycats quickly spirals into a deadly series of murders.

🚒 MAIN CAST

👨‍🚒 Greg Marker — 28

Lead / Firefighter / Secret Arsonist
Charismatic, fearless, and respected by his crew. Greg appears to be the firefighter everyone can trust, but behind closed doors he’s responsible for deliberately setting fires. When copycats emerge, he becomes obsessed with stopping them before they expose him.

👩‍🚒 Emma Callahan — 26

Firefighter
A determined young firefighter who works closely with Greg. She’s one of the first people to notice that Greg seems to know strangely specific details about certain fires.

👩‍🚒 Riley Bennett — 24

Firefighter / Rescue Specialist
Fearless and impulsive. Riley is often first into dangerous situations and becomes increasingly suspicious of Greg.

👩‍🚒 Madison “Maddie” Walsh — 27

Firefighter
The level-headed member of the crew. Her father was a firefighter, and she grew up around the department.

👩‍🚒 Ava Sullivan — 23

Firefighter / EMT
Youngest member of the crew. She has something to prove and becomes emotionally invested in uncovering the truth behind the fires.

👩‍🚒 Natalie “Nat” Russo — 29

Rescue Technician
Experienced, tough, and protective of the younger firefighters. She’s often the person called in when a fire turns into a rescue operation.

👩‍🚒 Chloe Parker — 25

Firefighter / EMT
Outgoing and funny outside of work but extremely serious during emergencies. She becomes close friends with Riley.

⸻

🚑 RESCUE & EMERGENCY CREW

👨‍🚒 Daniel Brooks — 30

Firefighter / Lieutenant
Greg’s superior and one of the few people who knew him before he became a firefighter. Daniel begins investigating inconsistencies in Greg’s behavior.

👨‍🚒 Tyler Grant — 26

Firefighter
Confident and competitive. He doesn’t immediately believe the copycat theory and thinks someone inside the department may be involved.

👨‍🚒 Marcus Reed — 29

Rescue Specialist
Calm under pressure and highly observant. Marcus notices patterns in the victims that others overlook.

👨‍🚒 Ethan Parker — 27

Firefighter
Chloe’s older brother. Protective of his sister and suspicious of anyone who puts her in danger.

👨‍🚒 Jake Morrison — 24

Firefighter / EMT
Young, ambitious, and eager to become a full-time firefighter. His investigation into one suspicious fire puts him dangerously close to Greg’s secret.

⸻

👧 DAUGHTERS OF FIREFIGHTERS

These characters can provide the younger-generation storyline outside the firehouse.

🎓 Sofia Callahan — 21

Emma’s younger sister
Her father was a legendary Boston firefighter. She idolizes her sister but doesn’t know how dangerous her job has become.

🎓 Brooke Walsh — 22

Maddie’s younger sister
A college student studying criminal justice. She becomes fascinated by the copycat arson investigation.

🎓 Lily Bennett — 20

Riley’s younger sister
Protective of Riley and convinced something is wrong with the department.

🎓 Hannah Russo — 23

Nat’s daughter
Works as an EMT trainee and hopes to eventually join the fire department herself.

⸻

🔥 GREG MARKER’S DAUGHTERS

Greg’s family creates an even darker layer to the story.

Sadie Marker — 21

Greg’s oldest daughter.
Smart, independent, and increasingly uncomfortable with her father’s strange behavior. She begins noticing unexplained things in his house.

Mia Marker — 18

Greg’s younger daughter.
Still believes her father is a hero. Her loyalty to him creates conflict when evidence begins pointing toward Greg.

Ella Marker — 15

Greg’s youngest daughter.
Quiet and observant. She may know more about her father’s secret than anyone.

To submit please send headshot, resume, reel and label who you’re interested in and which project to vintageproductions2026@gmail.com

Travel and lodging available 
IMDb credit
Paid

items.text:
Do jednego z ostatnich odcinków 21. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję PANA Z PIESKIEM do roli:

-Świadek (65) – typ emeryta z małej miejscowości, z psem. Szukamy pana z własnym pieskiem
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 700 zł netto za całość

Chętny Panów zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. Do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Informację kiedy ostatnio grali Państwo w serialu „Gliniarze” 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

Hallo zusammen! 
Ich bin aktuell als Kleindarsteller bei den Störtebeker Festspielen in Ralswiek im Einsatz und habe dabei richtig Freude an der Arbeit vor der Kamera und auf der Bühne gefunden.

Nach der Saison möchte ich gerne weitermachen und bin deshalb auf der Suche nach neuen Möglichkeiten als Kleindarsteller oder Komparse. Ob Film, Fernsehen, Werbung, Events oder andere spannende Projekte – ich bin für vieles offen und freue mich über jede Chance.

Falls ihr Tipps, Kontakte oder passende Angebote habt, schreibt mir gerne hier auf Facebook eine Nachricht. Auch das Teilen dieses Beitrags hilft mir sehr weiter.

Vielen Dank und vielleicht sieht man sich ja schon bald am Set!

FORMATION INTENSIVE DE 10 JOURS | AFDAS | MARSEILLE
«PERFECTIONNEMENT DU JEU FACE CAMÉRA : TRAVAIL DIRIGÉ PAR 5 RÉALISATEUR.RICE.S»
Du 05 au 16 octobre 2026 inclus 

Formation destinée aux acteur.rice.s pro souhaitant approfondir leur jeu face caméra et travailler dans des conditions proches d’un tournage.

À travers des exercices filmés, des scènes dirigées et des mises en situation, vous développerez la précision du jeu, l’écoute, la gestion du cadre et l’adaptation au rythme du plateau.

Émilie NOBLET
Réalisatrice & Scénariste
https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Émilie_Noblet
https://time-art.com/talent/emilie-noblet.htm

- Diplômée de La Fémis.
- Elle a réalisé le téléfilm Loulou (Arte, 3 Prix au Festival de La Rochelle 2023), ainsi que plusieurs épisodes des séries Parlement (France TV Slash / France Télévisions), Les 7 Vies de Léa (Netflix), et Zorro (Paramount+ / France Télévisions)
- Son premier long métrage, Bis Repetita (2024), présenté au Festival de l'Alpe d'Huez, reçoit le Prix Coup de cœur du Jury.
- Elle réalise Dix pour cent : le film dont la diffusion est prévue sur Netflix à partir du 10 septembre 2026.
- Elle est en écriture de son prochain long métrage. • Diplômée de La Fémis.
- Elle a réalisé le téléfilm Loulou (Arte), ainsi que plusieurs épisodes des séries Parlement (France TV Slash / France Télévisions), Les 7 Vies de Léa (Netflix), et Zorro (Paramount+ / France Télévisions)
- Son premier long métrage, Bis Repetita (2024), présenté au Festival de l'Alpe d'Huez, reçoit le Prix Coup de cœur du Jury.
- Elle réalise Dix pour cent : le film dont la diffusion est prévue sur Netflix à partir du 10 septembre 2026.
- Elle est en écriture de son prochain long métrage.

Lola QUIVORON
Réalisatrice & Scénariste
https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lola_Quivoron
https://www.zelig-fr.com/talent/quivoron-lola.htm

- Diplômée de La Fémis.
- Réalisatrice du long métrage Rodéo (2022), présenté en sélection Un Certain Regard au Festival de Cannes, où il reçoit le Prix Coup de cœur du Jury.
- Ses courts métrages (Fils du loup, Au loin, Baltimore, Ça brûle) ont été sélectionnés et récompensés dans de nombreux festivals internationaux.
- Co-réalisatrice du documentaire Headshot avec Antonia Buresi, diffusé sur ARTE dans le cadre de La Lucarne.
- Son deuxième long métrage, Grand Eldorado, un thriller familial, est actuellement en montage. Sortie cinéma prévue en 2027.
- Elle est parallèlement en écriture de son prochain long-métrage co-écrit avec Audrey Diwan.

Julien GASPAR-OLIVERI
Réalisateur, Acteur, scénariste
https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julien_Gaspar-Oliveri
https://www.agencesartistiques.com/Fiche-Artiste/686148-julien-gaspar-oliveri.html

- Formé au Conservatoire national supérieur d'art dramatique de Paris.
- Réalisateur des courts métrages Villeperdue, et L'Âge tendre nommé au César du Meilleur court métrage de fiction en 2022.
- Créateur et réalisateur de la mini-série Ceux qui rougissent (ARTE), Prix de la Meilleure série à Séries Mania 2024.
- Réalise son premier long métrage, La Frappe (2026), présenté en Séance spéciale à la Semaine de la Critique du Festival de Cannes puis en compétition officielle au Festival du Film Francophone d'Angoulême 2026. Le film sort en salles le 02 septembre 2026
- Comme réalisateur, il est actuellement en écriture de son prochain long-métrage (adaptation d'un livre).
- Comme acteur, on pourra le retrouver prochainement dans les séries Glamsquad (Amazon Prime) de Rebecca Zlotowski, et The Other Girl (RTS) de Sophie Jarvis.

Prïncia CAR
Réalisatrice & scénariste
https://time-art.com/talent/princia_car.htm

- Réalisatrice, scénariste et fondatrice d'une école alternative de cinéma à Marseille, où elle mène des ateliers de création avec de jeunes talents issus des quartiers populaires.
- Réalisatrice du long métrage Les Filles désir (2025), sélectionné à la Quinzaine des Cinéastes du Festival de Cannes, puis dans de nombreux festivals internationaux.
- Son film a notamment reçu le Prix Regards Méditerranéens au festival France Odéon (Florence) et le Prix AAMMA Women in Focus au Festival du film européen de Séville.
- Ses courts métrages, dont Barcelona, ont été sélectionnés dans de nombreux festivals, notamment au Festival international du court métrage de Clermont-Ferrand.
- Elle est actuellement en écriture de ses deux prochains films.

Annarita ZAMBRANO
Réalisatrice & scénariste
https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annarita_Zambrano
https://www.ubba.eu/fiche/realisateur/annarita-zambrano

- Réalisatrice et scénariste italienne, installée en France.
- Ancienne responsable du pôle pédagogique du Festival Paris Cinéma, où elle a développé le programme « Les Films de l'Avenir » consacré notamment aux premiers films.
- Ses courts métrages sont sélectionnés dans les plus grands festivals internationaux, notamment à la Berlinale, à la Mostra de Venise, à la Quinzaine des Réalisateurs et en Compétition officielle du Festival de Cannes pour Ophelia.
- Son premier long métrage, Après la guerre (Dopo la guerra), est présenté dans la sélection Un Certain Regard du Festival de Cannes 2017, après avoir reçu le Grand Prix du scénario Sopadin et le soutien de la Fondation Gan pour le Cinéma.
- Son deuxième long métrage, Rossosperanza (2023), est sélectionné en compétition au Festival de Locarno.
- Elle prépare actuellement son prochain long métrage, Le Choix du Roi, dont le tournage est prévu au printemps 2027 à Marseille.

Tout.e.s les intervenant.e.s sont en activité. 

INSCRIPTIONS OUVERTES
Envoyer votre dossier de candidature CV / Photos / Bande démo ou lien vers des images de jeu, à 
info@clapclass.fr ou directement sur notre site sur www.clapclass.fr 

- Financement AFDAS > Date limite de dépôt des dossiers le 05 septembre 2026

- Financement Pôle Emploi > Date limite de dépôt des dossiers le 30 août 2026

- Financement personnel > Possible dans la limite des places disponibles (nous contacter)

items.text:
Every week actors tell us they're "too" something.

Too old.
Too young.
Too Black.
Too Indigenous.
Too Asian.
Too white.
Too gay.
Too different.

We’ve heard every version.

**But I've seen more actors hold themselves back than I've ever seen casting hold them back.**

As a former agent, I learned something that changed the way I coach actors forever. It made me realize that waiting for permission is one of the fastest ways to stall a career.

In this free class, we talk about why Hollywood has changed, why there are more opportunities than many actors realize, and what you can do to become ready for the opportunities that are still being written.

**I'd love to know what you think after you watch it.**

🎬 Replay:
[https://youtu.be/bD503qxCJxI](https://youtu.be/bD503qxCJxI)

items.text:
Your next breakthrough won't happen by watching acting reels and tips online. 

It happens in the room.

Every actor reaches a point where talent isn't enough.

You know the lines.
You understand the scene.
But something still feels... performed.

That's where the real work begins.
Our 3-Month Intensive Acting Class is built for actors who want more than techniques-they want a process they can rely on. Through the marriage of improvisation and text, you'll learn to listen deeply, make bold choices, trust your instincts, and create performances that feel truthful every single time.

This isn't about becoming a different actor.
It's about becoming a more honest one.

→ Live Online

The actors who grow the most aren't the ones waiting for the perfect opportunity-they're the ones preparing before it arrives.
Your next audition could change your career.

Will you be ready when it does?

sharedPost.text:
😂 You used to be my peace… now you’re my reason for needing peace.

There was a time when resting my head on your chest felt like home. Safe, calm, comfortable.

Now? I’m checking the time, making imaginary appointments, suddenly remembering I need to “go sort something out,” and finding reasons not to answer the phone. 😭😂

My heart used to sing love songs around you.

Now it’s on repeat like:

🎶 Liar, liar, pants on fire… 🎶

Funny how someone can go from being your comfort zone to becoming the reason you need a quiet room, a cup of tea, and your phone on Do Not Disturb. 😂

No hate, no drama. Just personal growth… and a very strong urge to leave early. ✌️

#RelationshipHumour #FunnyButTrue #DatingHumour #ProtectYourPeace #LiarLiar #MovingOn #NoMoreDrama #LifeLessons #PeaceOverChaos #DoNotDisturb

💎DANCE DIAMONDS💎 
Liebe Tänzer, Dozenten und Choreografen,
wir erwarten euch alle zum internationalen Tanzwettbewerb „DANCE DIAMONDS” am 26. und 27. September 2026 in der Stadthalle Kleve.
Registration: www.art-element.de/registration-competition

💎Eingeladen sind Amateure jeden Alters und mit unterschiedlichem Level. Wir bieten folgende Niveau Einteilung an: 
BASIC AMATEURS
ADVANCED AMATEURS
HIGH LEVEL AMATEURS

💎Bühnentanzrichtungen:
Classical Ballet 
Neo Classic/ Contemporary/ Lyrical dance 
Nationaltanz, Folklore, Charakter-, Hof-, Historischer Tanz 
Hip Hop / Streetdance / Breakdance / Krump
Fusion / Vogue
Jazz-, Modern Dance/ Jazz Funk
Show Dance/Musical/ Stage Dance 
Open - Mix Dance Styles

💥DANCE DIAMONDS exclusive:
- professionelle Bühne, Technik und Personal;
- Stellproben auf Bühne der Teilnehmer nach Zeitplan;
- kostenlosen Livestream;
- feierliche Award-Zeremonie mit Trophäen, Medaillen, Diplomen und Souvenirs; 
-  besondere Geldpreise von "Art Element" e.V. – Zertifikate im Wert von 200, 300, 500 und 1.000 Euro.

🏆Wir gratulieren allen Teilnehmern und titulieren die Besten direkt am Veranstaltungstag als Sieger des Internationalen Dance Competitions, ohne vorherige Qualifikationen !

♥️DANCE DIAMONDS legt großen Wert auf die Darstellung einzigartiger und nicht wiederholbarer Magic Momente auf der Bühne, die von Performance-, Ausdrucks- und Talententhalt geprägt sind.

💎Die Anmeldung ist bis zum 16. September möglich.

🛎Mehr Info, Rules und Archive: 
www.art-element.de/dancediamondsregistration/dance-diamonds

🌐International dance competition “DANCE DIAMONDS” on September 26 and 27, 2026, at the STADTHALLE KLEVE, Lohstätte 7, 47533 Kleves in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany.

SZUKAMY AKTOREK / PERFORMEREK DO SHORTA „L(AI)GHT”

Kompletujemy obsadę do niezależnego krótkiego metrażu psychologicznego „L(AI)GHT” — filmu około 10–12 minut, który realizujemy jako proof of concept większej historii.

Film dotyczy samotności, relacji człowieka z AI, pamięci, bliskości i rozpadania się granicy między rzeczywistością, projekcją a halucynacją.

Szukamy aktorek / performerek do kobiecych ról związanych z postaciami Emily i Emily AI.

Interesują nas dwa bieguny:

— Emily realna: osoba ludzka, konkretna, zapamiętana, niedoskonała, związana z pamięcią, stratą, bliskością i tym, czego główny bohater nie potrafi już naprawdę dotknąć.

— Emily AI: figura bardziej idealna, spokojna, precyzyjna, oddalona, niemal lustrzana; nie tyle „kobieta z krwi i kości”, ile obraz, głos, projekcja, odpowiedź systemu na samotność bohatera.

Nie szukamy jednego oczywistego typu urody. Bardziej interesuje nas obecność, wrażliwość, głos, spojrzenie, inteligencja, tajemnica i gotowość do wejścia w subtelny, psychologiczny klimat filmu.

Klimat wizualny: mroczny / low-key, światło telefonu, ekran, lampka, noc, miasto, cisza, odbicia, AI, samotność, halucynacja.

Terminy robocze zdjęć:

— 29–30 sierpnia,

— 5–6 września.

Najpewniej Warszawa / okolice Warszawy.

Projekt jest obecnie non-profit / no-budget / artystyczny i rozwojowy. Szukamy osób, które chcą wejść w projekt twórczo, portfolio’owo i z chęci zrobienia czegoś ciekawego.

Przed wysłaniem scenariusza i pełnych materiałów podpisujemy krótkie NDA / dokument poufności.

Zgłoszenia proszę przesyłać na: upskymail@gmail.com

W zgłoszeniu prosimy o:

— imię i nazwisko,

— wiek,

— miasto,

— doświadczenie / szkoła / portfolio, jeśli jest,

— zdjęcia / wizytówkę / showreel,

— dostępność w terminach 29–30.08 oraz 5–6.09,

— informację, czy charakter non-profit / no-budget jest realny.

SUPPORTING ARTISTES WANTED FOR THE N.E.S.T. PROJECT!

We are looking for enthusiastic supporting artistes to join us for our upcoming filming scenes.

This is an incredible opportunity to step onto a real film set, experience the world of filmmaking, and become part of a growing independent feature film production.

Whether you are looking to gain on-set experience, develop your skills, meet like-minded creatives, or simply be part of something exciting, this is your chance.

By joining us, you will gain:

Real on-set experience
The opportunity to network with cast and crew
Insight into professional filmmaking processes
The chance to develop your understanding of how a production works
A unique experience being part of an ambitious feature film project

No previous experience is required. We are looking for people with enthusiasm, commitment, and a willingness to get involved.

N.E.S.T. is more than just a film; it is a community of creatives coming together to build something ambitious. We would love for you to be part of the journey.

If you are interested in joining us, reach out to find out more information.

🎬 CASTING CALL – SHORT FILM | THE RODMAN VIRUS
@
ANEU Media Group…

Seeking talented actresses for an emotionally driven psychological drama exploring modern dating, rebound culture, and the contagious nature of heartbreak.

LEAD – ESTHER (Female, 22–30, Black or Mixed Ethnicity)
Esther appears calm and confident, but beneath the surface is consumed by unresolved heartbreak. Esther hides her pain behind quiet composure, forcing the audience to discover her emotions through subtle expressions and silence. This role demands exceptional emotional depth, naturalism, and the ability to communicate powerful subtext with very little dialogue. Think understated, cinematic performances where the eyes do the acting.
PAYS $350/1day

No nudity but Must be comfortable doing cuddling scene with Male Lead. 

🎬

Project: The Rodman Virus (Short Film)
Genre: Psychological Drama /Thriller
Location: Los Angeles Area
Compensation: IMDb Credit, Craft Services, Copy of the Film, Festival Exposure 
[PAID]
Shooting 10/17

To Submit:
• Headshot
• Resume (if available)
• Demo Reel or Self-Tape (preferred)
• Contact Information

We’re looking for actors who excel in subtle, truthful performances and can tell a story through authentic emotional presence.

Please send submissions with the subject line: THE RODMAN VIRUS – [Character Name]

Check Aneu Media Group on IG:
https://www.instagram.com/aneumediagroup

Email:
princetonpa3@gmail.com
For audition instructions.

By drawing close to Hunter and projecting the feelings she showed towards her boyfriend Anthony, Esther causes Hunter to fall for her. Ultimately she gets back with Anthony and ghost Hunter, leaving Hunter hurt and looking to fill the void oflosing Esther.'

items.text:
**CASTING CALL & CREW NOTICE FOR INDIE SHORT FILM **

**TITLE:** Truffle Pig

**GENRE:** Elevated Arthouse Horror / Psychological Thriller / Drama *(Serious, grounded, and intense tone—not campy)*

**LOGLINE:** Hunted through the rugged Colorado wilderness, a man undergoes a harrowing, visceral transformation into a porcine predator to seek karmic retribution. A dark, elevated study on trauma, vengeance, and survival.

**ABOUT THE CREATOR:**

Randy Rochford is a Colorado-based multidisciplinary artist, actor, fashion model, dancer, and writer. He specializes in high-fashion editorial, physical theater, movement, and creature performance. He is the founder of Feelin' Just Dandy Productions, through which he develops original arthouse horror and character-driven thrillers.

**CREATIVE & PRODUCTION TEAM:**
* **Writer / Creative Producer / Casting Director:** Randy Rochford *(Feelin' Just Dandy Productions | Portraying 'Ronnie')*
* **Director / Executive Producer:** Brock Mason Crone *(Pioneer Entertainment)*

**CASTING ROLES:**
* **TYLER (Lead | Male, Late-20s–Mid-30s):** The primary antagonist driving a high-stakes pursuit through the wilderness. Rugged, intimidating, and calculating, Tyler conceals a sinister nature behind a facade of false charm and psychological manipulation. He stalks his target through the night with a shotgun, treating the hunt like a game of control. Complex, intense, and emotionally demanding—requires an actor who isn't afraid to push boundaries into raw, dark, and uncomfortable psychological territory. Must be comfortable with heavy thriller elements, intensity, outdoor night shoots, and SFX makeup/blood work.
* **RONNIE:** ***ROLE FILLED by ***Randy Rochford**.** The central protagonist. A vulnerable, desperate survivor who undergoes a harrowing physical and psychological metamorphosis in the woods—pushed to his absolute limits in a desperate fight for survival.
* **EXTRAS / CORPSES (4–5 Actors/Models | Open Gender, 18+):** Needed for atmospheric scene setup. Minimal/no movement required. Must be comfortable with SFX makeup (blood/bruising) and outdoor environments.

**CREW & PRODUCTION POSITIONS NEEDED:**
* **Special Effects (SFX) Makeup Artist:** Specialized in realistic blood, bruising, skin FX, and prosthetics.
* **SFX / Makeup Continuity Supervisor:** To maintain practical/blood alignment across multi-night shoots.
* **Wardrobe Master / Costume Designer:** Managing practical outdoor gear and distressed wardrobe.
* **Gaffer & Lighting Crew:** Experience with low-light, high-contrast night exterior setups.
* **Co-Producers / Executive Producers:** Additional creative/funding partners seeking to attach to an ambitious arthouse horror project. Script and full Pitch Deck Website available upon request for serious inquiries.

**AUDITION & SUBMISSION INFORMATION:**
* **Deadline to Submit:** August 20th, 2026 by 9:00 AM MST.
* **For Tyler Submissions:** Email headshot, resume, demo reel, and/or relevant dramatic clips to **randyrochford2@gmail.com** and CC **brock@pioneerentertainment.net** with the subject line *"Tyler - [First/Last Name] - Truffle Pig"*.
   * *Note:* Selected actors will receive sides for a self-tape audition.
   * *Self-Tape Slate Requirements:* First/Last Name, Height, Location, Representation status, and explicit confirmation that you are comfortable with dark thriller themes, SFX blood/violence, and semi-nude visual elements if required.
* **For Extras / Corpse Roles:** Email a **Headshot**, **Full-Body Shot**, and **3/4 Shot** (no reels or complex resumes required) to the emails above with the subject line *"EXTRA: Truffle Pig"*.
* **Crew & Production Applicants:** Email resume, portfolio/website link, and equipment/dept list to both emails listed above with the subject line *"CREW: [Department Name] - Truffle Pig"*.

**COMPENSATION:** Paid (NON-UNION), IMDb Credit, Meals/Craft Services provided, and Copy/Footage for reel.

**PRODUCTION TYPE:** Non-Union Independent Arthouse Short Film

**SHOOTING SCHEDULE:** 4–5 Night Shoots in Late July / Early August 2027 *(late-night exterior filming)*

**FILMING LOCATION:** Mountainous area surrounding Denver, CO

🎬 STATISTER SØGES TIL KORTFILMEN "EN DEL AF LEGEN"
Har du lyst til at være statist i en psykologisk thriller/drama, der er inspireret af en virkelig hændelse?

Vi søger statister til optagelserne af kortfilmen En del af legen, som finder sted på Sluseholmen (KBH) den 16. august.

Om filmen

30-årige Mikkel skal mødes med en kvinde, han har lært at kende gennem en datingapp. Hun inviterer ham hjem til et aftalt rollespil, hvor hun sætter alle reglerne. En af dem lyder:

"Hvis jeg skriger, skal du ikke stoppe. Det er bare en del af legen."

Mikkel tror, han ved, hvad han går ind til. Men da legen begynder, bryder virkeligheden sammen, og fortidens traumer får fatale konsekvenser.

Praktisk

📍 Mødested: Sluseholmen, København SV

🕓 Tid: Kl. 16.00 – ca. 20 (der tages forbehold for mindre ændringer, da det endelige dagprogram endnu ikke er færdigt)

Hvad skal du lave?

I filmens åbningsscene skaber du liv i gadebilledet hvor Mikkel introduceres.

I den efterfølgende scene ved en café skal nogle statister sidde ved cafébordene, mens andre passerer på fortovet, så området fremstår levende og naturligt.

Deltagelse er ulønnet, men vi sørger selvfølgelig for snacks og drikkevarer under optagelserne.

Hvis du har lyst til at være med, så send en mail til burcuucler@gmail.com – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

# **🚨 CASTING CALL: KEITH CRIMBLE 🚨**

One final paid role is available in RSVP, a new immersive dark-comedy horror experience taking place near Horsham, West Sussex, this October.

We’re looking for a brilliant male-presenting character actor to play Keith: a seemingly ordinary village-hall caretaker, devoted family man and keeper of far too many keys.

Must be confident with improvisation, audience interaction, comedy and horror. Playing age between 40 and 65. 

Final casting workshop:
📍 Warnham Village Hall, near Horsham
📅 Thursday 13 August
⏰ 12pm–4pm
💰 Paid role

Performances take place across selected Friday and Saturday evenings in October. Applicants must be able to travel reliably to Warnham.

To apply, email HI@EZRAIMMERSIVE.COM with:

• Headshot
• Acting CV, Spotlight or Mandy profile
• Showreel, if available
• Current location
• Confirmation that you can attend the casting workshop

Please tag or send this to anybody who might make a disturbingly good Keith.

📝 New on the blog: How ACT & the Meisner Flow Coaching Model can help you move from self-doubt back into creative freedom

If you're an actor, rejection isn't occasional — it's woven into the profession. But a single "no" rarely causes a creative block. It's the story we start telling ourselves afterwards that usually does: Maybe I'm not good enough. Everyone else is booking work. Perhaps I should stop trying.

In my latest blog post, I explore how Acceptance & Commitment Coaching (ACT) and my own Meisner Flow Coaching Model can help actors build a different relationship with rejection — one rooted in presence, self-trust, and psychological flexibility, rather than self-judgement.

If audition rejection has started to feel like more than disappointment, I hope this offers a different way forward. 🌿

Read it here:

✨ A HUGE THANK YOU FROM OUR ACT CREATIVE TEAM -Joanne Wallace, Leah Roehling, Heather Hatch and Abi Maclean ✨

✨ THE WIZARD OF OZ YOUTH EDITION! ✨

What a journey it has been… and what a way to finish it! 🌈💚

Our recent performances of The Wizard of Oz Youth Edition at Eden Court were an absolute triumph, and we honestly couldn’t be more proud of every single person involved.
The feedback we received was just incredible. We had audience members laughing, crying and cheering throughout both shows — and seeing our young performers receive such a wonderful response was something we will never forget. ❤️
Our team has only been together as ACT for one year, and this was our very first show. We knew we had something special, but the overwhelming support, talent and dedication shown by everyone has completely blown us away.

🌟 To our incredible young performers — you were absolute SUPERSTARS! You took to that stage with confidence, energy and heart, and you made Oz come alive. We could not be prouder of you. 🌟

Behind every great show is a huge team, and we want to take a moment to thank the amazing people who helped make it possible:

✨Brian Hill — Business side, props and advertising 
🎥 Miles Hatch — projections
🎬 Eva Still & Amy Smith — wings/backstage team.
❤️Yvonne Black-ACT Nana- always helping where can.👏 William MacDonald — assistance throughout
💚 Carla, Jane & Fiona — chaperoning and supporting our performers.

💄 A very special thank you to our wonderful parent helpers who took care of hair and make-up:Alison, Rebekah, Sarah, Verity, Laura, Jody & Jenn.You did an absolutely amazing job, and your help was so greatly appreciated!

🎭 To all our parent helpers, who gave their time to help backstage with dressing, tech and/or the shows:
Pete, Jody, Verity, Sam, Pam, Alison, Lucy, Allan, Gillian, Cerian, Marah, Mairi, Rachel, Laura, Lyndsay, Lindsay, Carole,Sarah,Rebekah 

Your support, patience and willingness to jump in wherever needed made such a difference. We genuinely couldn’t have done it without you. ❤️

✨ A huge thank you to everyone who donated through our fundraisers and helped towards the costs of putting our show together. We’re especially grateful to Martin for his incredibly generous donation, as well as for gifting our students their special show treat bags. Your kindness and support mean so much to us! ✨
  
🏛️ To the amazing team at Eden Court Theatre and Cinema — thank you for being so supportive, welcoming and fantastic to work alongside throughout our very first production. You helped make the whole experience so special for our young people and our team.

📸 To  Eoghan Smith Photography — thank you for capturing so many wonderful memories for us, we can’t wait to see them.
These are moments we will treasure for years to come.

And finally…
❤️ THANK YOU TO EVERY SINGLE AUDIENCE MEMBER! ❤️
Thank you for filling the theatre with your laughter, applause, cheers and support. Watching you get behind our young stars throughout both performances was genuinely magical. Your reaction meant more to them — and to all of us — than you will ever know.
This may have been our first show, but it certainly won’t be one we forget.
From a group who have only been together for a year, to a cast and crew who delivered something truly special…

🌈 There’s no place like home — but there was certainly nowhere like Oz! 🌈

Thank you for believing in us, supporting us and helping our first production become such an overwhelming success.

We are so, so proud. 💚✨

#WizardOfOz #WizardOfOzYouthEdition #EdenCourt #YouthTheatre #YoungPerformers #ThankYou #Proud #TheatreFamily #SomewhereOverTheRainbow

Aufruf für ein Theaterstück – Titel: „Hauptdarsteller“
Hallo zusammen,

wir beginnen bald mit den Proben für ein neues Theaterstück. Wir proben im Theaterhaus Mitte und planen eine Aufführung im Acud.

Das Stück trägt den Titel „Hauptdarsteller“ und ich suche noch Schauspielerinnen und Schauspieler, die Interesse haben, Teil dieser Produktion zu werden.

Bei Interesse schicke ich euch das Stück gerne zu.

Ein erstes Treffen können wir organisieren, sobald wir ein Team von ungefähr 5–10 Schauspieler*innen zusammengestellt haben.

Ich bin ausgebildete Theater- und Filmregisseurin (HFF) und habe unter anderem an der Volksbühne gearbeitet. Es ist eine professionelle Produktion mit professionellen Schauspieler*innen und professioneller Regiearbeit.

Die Produktion ist zunächst ohne Bezahlung geplant, allerdings können die Einnahmen aus den Eintrittsgeldern am Ende natürlich unter den Beteiligten aufgeteilt werden.

Geplant ist, am Anfang einmal pro Woche zu proben und die Proben später auf zwei- bis dreimal pro Woche zu erweitern.

Bei Interesse meldet euch gerne bei mir.

Liebe Grüße

Lydia

01783230952

eistvpro@gmail.com

----

Call for Actors – Theatre Production “Hauptdarsteller”

Hello everyone,

we will soon begin rehearsals for a new theatre production. We will rehearse at Theaterhaus Mitte and are planning a performance at Acud.

The play is called “Hauptdarsteller” and I am currently looking for actors and actresses who would like to become part of this production.

If you are interested, I would be happy to send you the script.

We will arrange a first meeting once we have assembled a team of approximately 5–10 actors.

I am a trained theatre and film director (HFF) and have, among other things, worked at Volksbühne. We are creating a professional production with professional actors and professional directing work.

The production is initially unpaid, but ticket revenue can of course be shared among the participants at the end.

The plan is to rehearse once a week at the beginning and later increase rehearsals to two or three times per week.

If you are interested, please feel free to contact me.

Best wishes,

Lydia

01783230952

eistvpro@gmail.com

KLEINDARSTELLERIN ÜBER 60 GESUCHT

Wir (UdK-Studentin, Mediengestalter Bild und Ton) suchen noch eine Kleindarstellerin für unseren Kurzspielfilm

„Danke, ich." Er soll beim KURZstummfilmfestival eingereicht werden.

Es handelt sich um einen Stummfilm mit dem Thema „blau".

Ein Drehbuch ist schon vorhanden.

Im besten Fall hast du BLAUE oder GRÜNE AUGEN und GRAUE HAARE (teilweise grau oder weiß ist auch in Ordnung)

SPIELALTER: ÜBER 60 (je älter, desto besser)

Ja es eine No-Budget-Produktion ist, können wir leider keine Gage anbieten. Für Verpflegung am Set ist gesorgt. Dafür eine Menge Spaß ein nettes Team und ein Drehtag in der Natur  Der Film soll Mitte September, voraussichtlich am 12./13.09. in Berlin gedreht werden.

Schick uns bei Interesse gerne hier eine Nachricht oder eine Email an juli.c1@gmx.de. Dann senden wir dir weitere Informationen zum Projekt. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören!

:)

Julia Collina

topComments.text: Schade dass sowas immer soooo weit weg ist.

items.text:
Be careful actors in the age of AI

#actors #casting #ai

sharedPost.text:
Are we in Deadline now?

The four of us would like to use our newfound fame to share something important.

Actors, please be careful out there.

We’re living in an age where AI can create incredibly convincing images, emails, casting notices, websites, social media accounts, videos, and even entire conversations. Something looking professional is no longer proof that it’s legitimate.

A few reminders from four casting directors who would very much like you to stay safe:

• Submit through reputable casting platforms and verified industry contacts whenever possible.

• Having a legitimate agent adds another layer of protection because there’s someone else helping verify what’s coming your way.

• Check who the casting director and production company actually are.

• Be extremely cautious about sending identification, banking information, intimate material, money, or other sensitive information.

• A recognizable company name, impressive salary, famous producer, or professional-looking breakdown doesn’t automatically make something real.

• If something feels strange, ASK QUESTIONS. Legitimate casting professionals won’t be offended that you’re protecting yourself.

• And please remember the oldest rule on the internet: if something seems too good to be true, it may be.

AI has made it easier than ever to make something fake look extremely real. That means we all need to get a little better at verifying before trusting.

And yes, before anyone asks, this Deadline article is fake too.

That’s kind of the point.

Monika Dalman, Ashley Wood, Lesley Lawson, and Tanya Keller

items.text: Ich laufe trauernd durch den Kölner Rheinauhafen und ihr hört meinen Text samt meiner Stimme: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1EfRUWLJnz/ Ich freue mich über euer Feedback 🎬 Christian Weiße

sharedPost.text:
Jeder Schritt schmerzt anders

Ich gehe heute allein durch den Rheinauhafen. Über Wege, die in den vergangenen zwei Jahren der Parcours, der Abenteuerspielplatz und die kleine große Welt unserer Aussiedoodle-Hündin Mayla waren. Jede Treppe, jede Mauer und jeder Geruch gehörten zu ihren Entdeckungen. Sie sprang, schnupperte, lernte und verwandelte jeden Spaziergang in ein gemeinsames Abenteuer.

Doch Mayla ist nicht mehr hier. Sie lebt jetzt an einem anderen Ort, zusammen mit der Frau, mit der ich fünfzehn Jahre meines Lebens geteilt habe. Der Frau, deren Hand ich auf all diesen Wegen gehalten habe, während ich in der anderen Maylas Hundeleine trug. Meine Partnerin auf der einen Seite, unser FellBaby auf der anderen. Genau so fühlte sich mein Leben vollständig an.

Nach der Trennung hätte ich niemals um Mayla streiten können. Nicht, weil sie mir weniger bedeutet, sondern weil ich beide so sehr liebe, dass ich aus unserem FellBaby keinen Gegenstand eines Kampfes machen konnte. Ich hätte es nicht ertragen, Mayla zwischen zwei Menschen zu ziehen, die einmal ihr gemeinsames Zuhause waren. Also blieb mir nur, loszulassen, obwohl sich in mir alles dagegen wehrt.

Jetzt gehe ich diese Wege ohne ihre Hand und ohne Maylas Leine. Jeder Schritt erinnert mich daran, was fehlt. Jeder Atemzug trägt Bilder, Stimmen und Augenblicke in sich, die noch immer lebendig sind, obwohl unser gemeinsames Leben nicht mehr existiert.

Ich frage mich, wie lange dieser Ort noch meine Gegenwart sein kann. Ob Köln und der Rheinauhafen noch eine Zukunft für mich bereithalten oder ob ich gehen muss, weil hier jede Minute zu einhundert Prozent mit ihnen verbunden ist.

Vielleicht ist Trauer genau das: weiterzugehen, obwohl jeder vertraute Weg plötzlich weh tut.

**CASTING CALL **

The project is a **tourism campaign for social media (Instagram Reels & TikTok).**

**About the project:**
The story follows three university friends from different countries who decide to get away for a weekend in Vilnius. The series shows their adventures and experiences during the trip.

**Role:**
**Hans – an artist from Berlin**
German, fluent in English.

If you’re interested or know someone who could be a good fit, please send me a DM with your **photos, showreel/acting experience and contact details**.

Feel free to share with anyone who might be interested.

Tak oto oficjana zapowiedź naszego horrorowo-komiksowego programu! 

Detektyw do spraw koszmarów obchodzi swoje 40te urodziny a my z tej okazji przygotowaliśmy dla was specjalny, całodniowy program pełen specjalnych gości, prelekcji, projekcji, konkursów i innych niemniej mrocznych niespodzianek dla wszystkich miłośników porządnej dawki grozy! 

Spotkajmy się w Zielonej Górze, 26 września 2026 podczas PolConu i jubileuszowej XL edycji Bachanalia Fantastyczne  !

Do zobaczenia! 
#dylandog #polcon #bachanaliafantastyczne

sharedPost.text:
Bachanalia Fantastyczne i Polcon obchodzą w 2026 roku okrągłą 40 rocznicę❗🎉
Podczas nadchodzącego konwentu czeka Was moc atrakcji, fantastyczni gości i świetna zabawa 🙂

W trakcie wrześniowego festiwalu będziemy świętować jeszcze jedną 40 rocznicę, a mianowicie 40. urodziny Dylana Doga❗ 🎉
„Dylan Dog: 40 lat koszmarów", bo tak będzie nazywać się wydarzenie organizowane w ramach bloku komiksowego, zgromadzi autorów komiksu oraz redaktorów i tłumaczy pracujących nad jego polską wersją 🇵🇱 

Prosto z Włoch 🇮🇹 przyjadą specjalnie dla Was legendarni twórcy związani z serią, których nazwiska poznacie już wkrótce❗
Obok zagranicznych gwiazd w panelach dyskusyjnych i spotkaniach wezmą udział cenieni polscy krytycy komiksowi.

Kurator wydarzenia KP ZAKRZEWICZ z kanału dylandogpl (https://www.instagram.com/dylandogpl) zaprezentuje unikalną kolekcję komiksów z serii Dylan Dog. Wystawa obejmie niemal wszystkie wydania oryginalne, rzadkie edycje kolekcjonerskie, a także unikatowe numery wydane w różnych zakątkach Europy i świata 🌍

To nie wszystko❗
Wydawnictwo LeTra zaprezentuje dorobek literacki i komiksowy Barbary Baraldi (obecnej redaktorki naczelnej serii) podczas pierwszego polskiego zlotu jej miłośników.

Nie minie nas oczywiście spotkanie z polskim wydawcą Dylana Doga - Tore Oficyna Wydawnicza, długo oczekiwana premiera czy panele dyskusyjne poświęcone kinu giallo i komiksom nero.

Wydarzenie zostało objęte patronatem Istituto Italiano di Cultura di Varsavia ❗ Dziękujemy za zaufanie ♥

Parę słów o Dylanie Dogu

Dylan Dog to główny bohater i jednocześnie tytuł włoskiej serii komiksów, która ukazuje się już od 1986 roku❗
"Detektyw do spraw koszmarów" od 40 lat rozwiązuje nietypowe zagadki kryminalne, które naznaczone są horrorem 💀 i grozą ale też czarnym humorem i groteską. 
Bohaterowi zdążyło się również połączyć siły z innym wybitnym detektywem 🦇 w komiksie jednego z naszych wspaniałych gości "Dylan Dog/Batman: Cień Nietoperza". 

We Włoszech 🇮🇹 ukazało się już 480 tomów a na polskim 🇵🇱 rynku komiks gości od 2001 roku.

#BachanaliaFantastyczne #Polcon2026 #BF26 #ZielonaGóra #DylanDog #DylanDog40LatKoszmarow

items.text:
Crew Call: Co-Director
Hey everyone! My name is Kalyn Andrea, I’m currently the LP for a proof of concept short filming here in LA. We are having a crew call for a co-director to take over during our second film week.

Details: this is a 23 pg script. You will be directing the second film week shooting the third act and prologue scene- about 9 pages total. The scene will have minimal stunts - but we have a stunt coordinator choreographing stunts with the actors and he will be on set as well. SFX will be used but minimal, nothing too gory. Film is written to be as realistic as possible. 

Synopsis- story follows 2 detectives who are searching for an infamous Russian mob boss. 

Compensation: Volunteer based/non paid, great opportunity to get creative and build experience! Credit will be given both in and off screen, as well as IMBD. Meals and crafty will be provided. Copy of the film provided! Lastly, great networking opportunities as we have an amazing crew ready to work on this film! ☺️

Shoot dates: Sept 5,6.

Film location: TBD but area scope is between SFV and SGV 

If you are interested please PM me, let’s chat and connect! 🥰 if you PM me, please leave a comment here so that I may be aware! Thanks so much for your time and consideration, hope to hear from you!

items.text:
Hello everyone! I'm shooting a low-budget period drama short set in the early 1800s. 🎬

Locations are confirmed - a couple of grand estate houses in Shropshire and a beautiful coast on the Isle of Anglesey. Filming is** 27th-29th August** plus one further day in mid-September.

**Crew needed:**
* Boom Operator / Sound Recordist *(paid role)*
* Make-up Artist

**Cast needed:**
* Steward (male, 50+)

The Sound Recordist is a paid position. The remaining roles are expenses-covered, with meals, a credit, and a copy of the finished film provided.

Keen to get involved? Comment below or drop me a DM and I will provide more information. 

Please share with anyone who might be a good fit!

Hi all! 
I'm looking for a few (max 10) UK actors who would like to try my rehearsal app Blablabla on ios and get a free month for some feedback? (It's free to try on the first 2+ scenes with full voice). 

You basically upload a script, choose your character and rehearse with the voices that always waits for you. It's a really good line learner and selftape scenepartner!) 

Let me know if you want to test and I will get the free month to you for some feedback! 

Bests, Elias

CASTING CALL - DOCTOR (VOICEOVER)

We are looking for someone to play the role of DOCTOR for our upcoming short film “A Man in Isolation: 2020”. This role is voiceover only, therefore you will not be needed on set, and this role is unpaid.

You will get a credit for A Man in Isolation: 2020 on Letterboxd and IMDB. Because the role is voiceover, we will be looking for this to be done between the end of August - beginning of September, so when we begin filming, it is all done and ready for post-production. Film is looking at an end of December - beginning of January release date (TBD)

Anyone can apply!

Interested? Get in contact via [amaninisolation@gmail.com](mailto:amaninisolation@gmail.com) for more information!

Don Cheadle Fans = American actor, producer, and director.
Versatile actor known for dramatic roles, Marvel, and playing smooth, smart characters with range. 
 _Boogie Nights_, _Out of Sight_, _Traffic_
- *Oscar-nominated*: _Hotel Rwanda_ as Paul Rusesabagina 
- *Marvel*: *James "Rhodey" Rhodes / War Machine* in the MCU since _Iron Man 2_
- *TV*: _House of Lies_ — won a Golden Globe. Also _The Falcon and the Winter Soldier_, _Secret Invasion_
- *Vibe*: Known for playing intelligent, complex leads. Also does comedy, directing, and producing. He directed _Miles Ahead_ where he played Miles Davis

He’s been acting since the 80s and has that reputation for picking thoughtful projects while also doing big blockbusters. 
#actor #acting #sunday #reels

items.text:
**Hey actors,**

I built a library of free scenes to practice, stay warm - and make you ready for when the real casting or script comes along. They are free to use - forever - with full voice coverage in 30+ languages. They play back when you have said your lines and always wait until you’re ready!

They use the blablabla app (free), where you normally just upload a script, select your character and rehearse.

And here we skip the first part - so all you have to do is go to sayblablabla dot com and choose what scene you want to practice and then go wild!

Let me know if you like it, have any feedback (on the scenes, the app, anything) or if there are any other scripts you’d like to have included.

I built this because I sometimes felt that there was nothing for me to practice on, and it often felt like the actors landing the roles were the ones who were warm.

Now this is our chance to always be warm too!

Break a leg,

Elias

Do jednego z ostatnich odcinków 21. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze”, realizowanego w Warszawie (i bliskich okolicach) poszukuję PANA Z PIESKIEM do roli:

-Świadek (65) – typ emeryta z małej miejscowości, z psem. Szukamy pana z własnym pieskiem
Data: 19.08
Stawka: 700 zł netto za całość

Chętny Panów zapraszam do wysyłania PILNYCH zgłoszeń na adres: casting.outset@interia.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila proszę o wpisanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. Do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Informację kiedy ostatnio grali Państwo w serialu „Gliniarze” 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

items.text:
🎬 **Schauspieler / Kleindarsteller / Komparse aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

Hallo zusammen,

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin 41 Jahre alt, 1,94 m groß und lebe in Hamburg.

Ich bin aktuell auf der Suche nach **seriösen Film- und TV-Produktionen sowie Möglichkeiten als Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse** – gerne für Filme, Serien, Werbespots, Musikvideos, Imagefilme oder andere spannende Projekte.

Ich stehe noch **am Anfang meiner schauspielerischen Laufbahn** und möchte in erster Linie weitere Erfahrungen vor der Kamera sammeln, mich weiterentwickeln und verschiedene Einblicke in die Film- und Medienbranche bekommen.

Erste Erfahrungen konnte ich bereits als **Komparse bei einem Filmdreh** sammeln. Die Arbeit am Set hat mir sehr viel Freude gemacht und meinen Wunsch bestärkt, künftig noch häufiger vor der Kamera zu stehen.

Ich bin **zuverlässig, pünktlich, motiviert, lernbereit und teamfähig** und freue mich darauf, neue Erfahrungen zu sammeln und mich auf unterschiedliche Projekte einzulassen.

Ich bin sowohl für **einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte** offen. Anfragen aus Hamburg und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet sind herzlich willkommen.

📩 Bei Interesse freue ich mich über eine Nachricht. **Aktuelle Fotos, meine Vita und weitere Informationen** sende ich gerne auf Anfrage zu.

Ich freue mich über interessante Projekte, neue Erfahrungen und nette Kontakte in der Film- und Medienbranche!

Viele Grüße
Nicolay Bein
